status: Rejected. Exact verified app source and 9e20 assets restored.

trigger.finding: The sidebar UTF-8 comparator allocates two complete code-point arrays before it can return on the first difference.
trigger.profileEvidence: 766 inclusive sample points, 712 self sample points, in the 96222-point streaming window. Counts are diagnostic, not CPU time.

implementation.purpose: Compare code points until the first difference without allocating full arrays. Preserve SQLite UTF-8 ordering, ASCII-only NOCASE, Unicode planes, prefixes and existing lone-surrogate order.
implementation.visualChanges: No markup, styles, controls, gestures, localization or scroll ownership changes were proposed. The full candidate is removed.

red.reason: A difference at the first code point still caused 20,002 code-point reads.

productionBuild.purpose: Uncommitted SQLite comparison prototype. Private benchmark complete; full-view qualification pending.

configurationRejection.reason: The build omitted KANDEV_I18N_BUNDLE_PSEUDO=1. Control includes i18n-pseudo.js and its gzip sibling. This build was not used for browser checks or timing.
configurationRejection.recovery: Repeat production build with the same pseudo-locale bundling setting as the frozen control. Keep app source unchanged.

microbenchmark.limits: Private comparator only, not app main-thread work, frame responsiveness, INP or M2 Air performance. Unmodified production function declarations extracted with the pinned TypeScript parser and compiled identically. Full-view comparison remains pending.

microbenchmarkLimit: 98.1439% median local sort-time reduction across six alternating pairs. This does not establish a full-view gain. Exact input and output order are verified; the primary source declarations are extracted and compiled identically.

decision.acceptance: No full-view streaming gain established. Prototype remains uncommitted while task-switch behavior and cost are assessed. No six-pair confirmation yet.
decision.samplerAuditOrderNote: Post-audit started with expected sampler exit 0 before its tool handle confirmed termination. Actual sampler exit 0 was confirmed before this acceptance analysis; no timing result was accepted before terminal confirmation.

notes: mainThreadMs and mainThreadMsPerSecond use TaskDuration with timeTicks: elapsed time in main-thread tasks, not thread CPU time. Script, style, and layout durations use the same elapsed-time domain.
mainThreadCpuMs uses ThreadTime (renderer main-thread CPU). rendererCpuMs uses ProcessTime (renderer-process CPU); it excludes separate browser, GPU, and backend processes.
Positive reduction means a lower candidate value. Counts such as mounted editors are observations, not optimization scores.
Frame gaps and driver DOM readiness are not INP. Linux CPU throttling is not an M2 Air simulation.

Extra busy headers are backend-seeded status rows, not additional live executions. The six canonical stream producers remain unchanged. Busy-header variants must not be pooled with the default workload.
Final-content probe versions must not be pooled. Locator-assertion retries can collect page-wide ARIA snapshots; boolean polling retains the same visibility gate without those snapshots.

Scripted input variants have a separate mode and window prefix. Their later idle windows can retain composer state changed by those inputs. Action timestamps preserve late execution; they do not imply that all inputs completed on schedule.
Streaming duration includes the wait for final visible content. Fixed-deadline traffic is retained in the raw report.
History decoded bytes include captured requests and responses. They are not compressed network transfer.

streamingComparison.disposition: All four attempts pass and verify 7200 ordered updates. Streaming main-thread task rate is slightly worse in both pairs. Normalized script rate is mixed; normalized style and layout rates increase in both. Cold readiness and reduced-motion idle work are worse in both pairs. All 70 rows remain intact.

postAudit.limits: Existing task-switch browser readiness timing, not INP or screen presentation. CPU profiles are collected after timing. Retained heap observations do not establish a leak. Default 1000-task seed is source verified, not a separately recorded final count.

notes: mainThreadMs and mainThreadMsPerSecond use TaskDuration with timeTicks: elapsed time in main-thread tasks, not thread CPU time. Script, style, and layout durations use the same elapsed-time domain.
mainThreadCpuMs uses ThreadTime (renderer main-thread CPU). rendererCpuMs uses ProcessTime (renderer-process CPU); it excludes separate browser, GPU, and backend processes.
Positive reduction means a lower candidate value. Counts such as mounted editors are observations, not optimization scores.
Frame gaps and driver DOM readiness are not INP. Linux CPU throttling is not an M2 Air simulation.
Browser-event readiness uses trusted pointerdown timestamps and frame-sampled DOM/owner state without geometry reads. It is separate from driver-clock readiness and is not screen presentation or INP.

navigationComparison.disposition: All four attempts pass, with 160 measured switches and 200 additional retention switches. Driver selection p95 is 10.02% and 14.06% slower; browser all-ready p95 is 7.73% and 13.64% slower. Main-thread work increases 3.49% and 7.76%. All 28 rows remain intact.
navigationComparison.densityLimit: Default 1000-task inventory is source verified. Each prepared task separately records 1000 messages, 630 files and 73 changes. There is no separately recorded final inventory count.

preservation.status: Rejected app candidate preserved before restoration.
preservation.decision: Full-view streaming task rate did not improve. Navigation p95 was worse in both pairs. No six-pair confirmation or production acceptance.

decision: Reject the full app candidate. A useful isolated function gain does not override the adverse full-view observations. These comparisons do not establish the cause of the regressions. No six-pair confirmation or M2 gain is claimed.
